Managed legacy rejected before device access; secure pool validation remains in dispatcher; no fake trusted_network.

Only managed bind installs ServerMonitor; admission still before claim, unacknowledged actual terminal not discarded as capacity relief.
Physical grant identities stored before subsequent recording; initializer is directly awaited and stop prevents later bind.
Network server shutdown then actual physical close occurs before all received grant Finish attempts; errors retained and remaining grants attempted.
All helper Finish requests occur before application finish/observe awaits; observer task retained and joined after actual close/Finish.
Cleanup vector is per grant, not equated with output success or persistence ACK; unconfirmed owners prevent fake Finish.
Foreground output delivery queue bounded, sticky stop interrupts receipt without dropping actual runner; terminal event returned in JobOutcome.
No-input CLI keeps control sender alive; enabled real EOF sends explicit Eof; bounded 4096 parser and queue2 do not own leases.
CLI signal branch retains owner join, output deadline delivered to owner, final output skipped for in-flight canceled stdout.
